answer_2.quote: Following , we reported the official automatic metrics to evaluate the methods: Hits@1, Perplexity (ppl) and F1.

answer_4.quote: we also performed crowdsourced human evaluations on the state-of-the-art baselines and our proposed P 2 BOT. Concretely, on the original dev set, we randomly sampled 200 responses generated by these methods and asked each worker to rate them.
answer_4.guideline: The rating ranges from 1 to 4. 1 means the response is good only in terms of grammar and sentence structure; 2 means in addition to valid grammar, the response is also coherent with the context; 3 means the coherent response is meanwhile interesting and informative, instead of just a simple response like "Yes"; And 4 means the response is consistent with the persona of the interlocutor.
